places.name: Designmuseum Danmark
places.note: A rococo hospital turned into the story of the Danish chair. The garden courtyard is a calm reset after Bredgade.

places.name: Grundtvig's Church
places.note: An expressionist cathedral built from six million yellow bricks, organ-pipe facade and all. Inside, nothing but brick and light.

places.name: Cisternerne
places.note: A disused underground reservoir beneath a park, now dark, wet and used for exhibitions. Only glass pyramids give it away above ground.

places.name: The Black Diamond
places.note: The Royal Library's black granite extension, leaning over the harbour. Walk through the glass atrium into the quiet old reading rooms.

places.name: Superkilen
places.note: A kilometre-long park of objects from 60 countries, by BIG, Topotek 1 and Superflex. The red square, black market and green park each play differently.

places.name: Assistens Kirkegård
places.note: A cemetery that works as a park. Kierkegaard and Hans Christian Andersen lie among the lime trees, and locals picnic nearby.

places.name: Radisson Collection Royal Hotel
places.note: Arne Jacobsen's 1960 tower, the first design hotel. Room 606 is kept as he furnished it, Egg chairs included.

places.name: Apollo Bar
places.note: A museum café in the courtyard of Kunsthal Charlottenborg, lit by PH lamps. Breakfast to late wine, a few steps and a world away from Nyhavn.

places.name: Hart Bageri
places.note: Richard Hart's sourdough bakery on Gammel Kongevej. The cardamom bun is the order. Arrive early on a Saturday; it sells out.

places.name: CopenHill
places.note: A waste-to-energy plant with a ski slope on its roof. BIG's landmark that is also a park; walk the trail up for the harbour view.

places.name: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art
places.note: Modern art in low glass corridors winding through a sculpture park to the sea. Worth the 35-minute train.

places.name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
places.note: A brewer's museum of sculpture around a palm-filled winter garden. The rooftop terrace looks over Tivoli.

places.name: SMK – National Gallery
places.note: Danish golden age painting and a glass extension along the park. The sculpture street links old and new.

places.name: Thorvaldsens Museum
places.note: A sculptor's museum painted in Pompeian colours, every room a different hue. One of Europe's first purpose-built museums.

places.name: Copenhagen Contemporary
places.note: Huge installation art in an old welding hall on Refshaleøen. Combine it with a harbour swim.

places.name: Danish Architecture Center
places.note: Exhibitions on architecture in BLOX, OMA's stacked glass block on the harbour. Good bookshop.

places.name: Rundetaarn
places.note: A 17th-century observatory climbed by a spiral ramp, not stairs. The view over the rooftops at the top.

places.name: Kastellet
places.note: A star-shaped fortress with grassy ramparts, red barracks and a windmill. A walk around the moat at dusk.

places.name: Royal Library Garden
places.note: A hidden garden between the old library and parliament. A fountain, a pond, near-silence.

places.name: Botanical Garden Palm House
places.note: An 1874 glass palm house with a cast-iron spiral stair to the gallery. Warm in winter.

places.name: Bagsværd Church
places.note: Utzon's church: a plain shed outside, a billowing concrete cloud of a ceiling inside. A short train ride out.

places.name: Ordrupgaard
places.note: French and Danish painting in a manor with Hadid and Snøhetta extensions, plus Finn Juhl's own house in the garden.

places.name: Illums Bolighus
places.note: Four floors of Scandinavian design, from cutlery to chairs. The template of the Danish design shop.

places.name: Torvehallerne
places.note: Two glass market halls with smørrebrød, coffee and Danish produce. Lunch at the counters.

places.name: La Banchina
places.note: A tiny harbour café with a jetty, a sauna and natural wine. Swim first, then lunch.

places.name: Juno the Bakery
places.note: A small Østerbro bakery known for its cardamom buns. Expect a queue on weekend mornings.

places.name: Ved Stranden 10
places.note: A wine bar in canal-side rooms with design classics for furniture. Natural and classic wines, little plates.

places.name: Atelier September
places.note: A white, light café known for its avocado on rye. Small and beautiful, the original of the city's café style.

places.name: The Lakes
places.note: Three long lakes on the edge of the centre. Dronning Louise's Bridge is where the city sits out in the evening.

places.name: Marble Church
places.note: A great green dome at the end of the Amalienborg axis. Climb it in summer for the view over the harbour.
